packageRules.description: VanillaBP, the Business Cockpit and the BPMS adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up. Once the Camunda 8 adapter is released per line, the camunda8-adapter.version.line-* properties of the POM are what moves, and the preset extended above keeps each of them inside its own line.

Camunda stays manual. Client and cluster are only guaranteed compatible at equal versions, and a cluster upgrade in a customer project takes its time, so a library must never force one. The client pins here follow the pins of vanillabp/camunda8-adapter rather than the newest release.

Protobuf arrives with the Camunda client and stays on the version that client generated its code against. The property exists to beat the Spring Boot BOM, not to be the newest one available: an application whose protocol classes were generated by another gencode version fails with an ExceptionInInitializerError on the first command. It is raised by hand when a client pin moves.
